conditions: inosine supplementation in neurodegenerative disease patients
solid tumor patients on anti-PD-1 therapy
question: Do any published studies report absolute concentrations (μmol/g tissue or μM) of microbiome-derived metabolites (inosine, short-chain fatty acids, bile acids) measured directly in human tumour tissue or tumour interstitial fluid from immune checkpoint inhibitor-treated patients, correlated with clinical response?
usable_content:
现有证据与用户询问的“肿瘤组织或间质液绝对浓度”存在样本部位不一致，未直接报告肿瘤内代谢物绝对值。1. 对象与设置差异：肌苷数据来自神经退行性疾病患者（血清尿酸 6-7 mg/dL）或药代动力学比较（半衰期 15 h vs ~5 s），非 ICI 治疗肿瘤患者。SCFA 数据来自 ICI 治疗队列，但样本为粪便（52 例抗 PD-1 固体瘤，11 例 NSCLC 二线 nivolumab）或血清（抗 CTLA-4 队列）。2. 结果方向不一致：粪便短链脂肪酸（乙酸/丙酸/丁酸/戊酸）较高提示正向关联（更长无进展生存期，其中 NSCLC 粪便丙酸/丁酸报告显著相关）；血清丁酸和丙酸较高提示负向关联（与 ICI 疗效负相关）。3. 统计与推论限制：仅 NSCLC 粪便研究明确报告显著性，其余为关联性描述；总体统计不代表组间差异显著，无肿瘤组织浓度数据支持机制。适用条件：仅适用于外周样本（粪便/血清）代谢物作为疗效预测标志物的参考，不可外推至肿瘤微环境内绝对浓度或因果机制。
inosine supplementation in neurodegenerative disease patients / serum urate concentration 6-7 mg/dL / up to 3 g/d for 2 years：inosine treatment group: 6-7 mg/dL serum urate
inosine vs adenosine half-life / inosine 15 h, adenosine ~5 s / pharmacokinetic comparison：inosine: 15 h；adenosine: ~5 s
solid tumor patients on anti-PD-1 therapy / fecal SCFA association with PFS / 52 patients, nivolumab or pembrolizumab：higher fecal acetate/propionate/butyrate/valerate: longer progression-free survival
NSCLC patients on second-line nivolumab / fecal propionate and butyrate association / 11 patients：propionate and butyrate: significantly associated with long-term beneficial effects
patients on anti-CTLA-4 (ipilimumab) / serum butyrate and propionate correlation / ICI-treated cohort：high serum butyrate and propionate: negatively correlated with ICI efficacy
